(omi-module canon.literate-orbit-smoke
  (source "tests/fixtures/canon-operational-literate.org")
  (authority
    (declaration executable-candidate)
    (accepted-state false)
    (validation downstream)
    (receipt pending))
  (define-function gf16-mul-alpha (x)
    (u16
      (if (ne (band x 0x8000) 0)
        (bxor (shl x 1) 0x002D)
        (shl x 1))))
  (define-function orbit-delta16 (x c)
    (u16 (bxor (gf16-mul-alpha x) c)))
  (test orbit
    (expect (gf16-mul-alpha 0x8000) 0x002D)
    (expect (orbit-delta16 0x1234 0x00FF) 0x2497)))
